about_the_game:
Available for PC, with native VR and Virtual Pinball Cabinet support.

Warning: Neural pathways may rewire during gameplay.

Side effects include questioning existence, seeing m﻿usic as pinball trajectories, loss of objective reality and uncontrollable urge to replay. Infected Mushroom and Rayworks are not responsible for any lost sense of time, space, or sanity. Consult your shaman if effects persist.


Quick tips for making the top 10

Game Modes - You earn the most points by completing Game Modes

Mode selection begins when the middle mushroom eats the ball. By completing game modes, you earn a lot of points, and new modes will unlock as you progress.

Skill & Combo Shots - Your path to the Extra Ball starts here

When you see the metal rails moving, it means a combo or skill shot opportunity is active. These shots are a great way to earn points. A successful combo skill shot returns the ball to the plunger, giving you a chance to attempt the Extra Ball skill shot.

Special Modes - Chase the ball into alternate dimensions

Find a way to unlock Special Modes, and flow through the melodies with perfect rhythm to make your score skyrocket.

Multiball - Jackpots grow with every locked ball

During Multiball, every mushroom on the playfield turns into a Jackpot target. Jackpot value is determined by how many balls are locked when Multiball begins.

Bonus Multiplier - Boost your game mode completion bonus, up to 4X

Earn even more points from game modes by increasing your bonus multiplier. Light up all the top lanes by passing the ball through each one.

Nudging - Don’t be shy. This machine likes it rough

Standing still won’t get you anywhere. Get physical. This baby wants action, and it likes it rough. Shake it and slap it like you mean it. If it tilts, you might’ve gone too far… or maybe not far enough.

Difficulty Multiplier - Find the perfect balance for your playstyle

Crank up the table difficulty to boost your point multiplier. Shrink the flippers, raise the challenge of game modes, and fine-tune how easily the machine tilts.

Mushroom Multiplier - Every flip matters. Build it, don't burn it.

As long as no game mode is active, the Mushroom Multiplier grows every time the ball rolls over the inlane switches. Once a game mode begins, you start with the multiplier you’ve built up and have a chance to score big, but every flipper press reduces your multiplier.

name: Infected Mushroom Pinball

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 2600X, Intel Core i7-6800K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 5700, GeForce 980
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Native support for VPIN Cabinets
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600X, Intel i5-10600K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RX 6800 XT, GeForce RTX 2080S
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • VR Support: All Open XR compatible headsets, motion controllers and virtual pinball VR cabinets. Seated, standing or room scale.
  • Additional Notes: Native support for VPIN Cabinets

short_description: Whether you´re a music lover, a hardcore pinball fan or just curious about pushing boundaries of virtual experiences, Infected Mushroom Pinball is your gateway to next-level audiovisual immersion, where the line between real and virtual blurs.
